dogecoin.text: But like many who got into $DOGE and NFTs, this is their first time experiencing crypto/tokens. Nearly every meeting I have with a Member or their staff usually involves the discussion of either of the two. Education is key to good policy and we welcome Capitol Hill's interest.

This week in Congress and crypto: For better or for worse, pop culture interest in $DOGE and NFTs has made its way to Capitol Hill. A few Members of Congress have told me that their colleagues talk about it on the House floor between votes. Some suspicious, others excited.
